The '''father''' of [[Barel Ovair]] was said to be a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] ostensibly operating as a [[Jedi historian]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. He visited the tomb of a deceased [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in order to eliminate it as a threat prior to the [[Great Galactic War|invasion]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. His role and duties were inherited from his [[Barel Ovair's grandfather|father]] and were passed on to his son, Barel Ovair. Jedi historian [[Gnost-Dural]] was the first to discover the true loyalties of the [[Ovair family|Ovair line]], over a century after Barel Ovair's mission to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[3756 BBY]].<ref name="Time7" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Barel Ovair's father was first introduced in a [http://swtor.com/news/news-article/20100416_001 timeline entry] for the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' video game.<ref name="Time7" />
